scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Monday’s virtual ergonomics follow-up able to review actual home-desk measurements rather than becoming a general discussion.
Emerging Need: The visit gains an upload deadline for measurements, and the only rigid tape measure at home is no longer available before the weekend.
Decision Context: Saved physical-therapy guidance distinguishes rigid measurements from casual estimates and points to a borrow-and-hold option; current emails and home messages define the remaining pickup window.
Consequence: If the tool-lending hold window closes, the required measurements cannot be completed before the upload cutoff, though the follow-up has not started.

parameter.title: Virtual ergonomics follow-up
parameter.description: Follow-up on home documentation setup for upcoming report-writing load.

parameter.subject: Prep items for Aug 10 ergonomics follow-up
parameter.body: For Monday's virtual ergonomics follow-up, please upload two home-desk photos plus chair-seat height and desk-height measurements by Sunday, Aug 9 at 6:00 PM so the therapist can review them before the visit. If measurements are not available, the appointment can still cover general questions.

parameter.content: Entryway drawer check while I was sorting: the metal tape measure isn't here anymore. It went out with the community-center donation box on Monday. The only thing left in the basket is the soft sewing tape.

parameter.subject: Friday measuring-tool holds
parameter.body: Member notice: two rigid 25-foot tape measures are available for no-cost short holds this week. Hold requests received by Friday, Aug 7 at 3:00 PM can be picked up Friday 4:00-6:00 PM or Saturday 9:00-11:00 AM at the Govans Tool Library desk, 5104 York Road. After 3:00 PM Friday, unheld tools go to walk-ins.

parameter.subject: Measuring-tool hold queue closed
parameter.body: The Friday hold queue is now closed, and the remaining tape measures have been released to walk-in members. The next reservable pickup time for measuring tools is Monday, Aug 10 after 11:00 AM.
